question: In a certain coded language 'JAMB' is coded as 'KBNC' and 'BOND' is coded as 'CPOE'. How will 'COIR' be coded in the same code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/083cd759b5320da976d162c0a2b294b9291ed7c6c269d41da231c4acbf6a9a21.png] The logic followed here is: Logic: Each letter of the word is replaced by the next letter in the English alphabetical series (+1). Here, JAMB → KBNC
